channel.title: Badcode
channel.description:
Sci-fi short films, music videos and Shorts about money, work and the cost of living. Told by an AI from a future that went wrong.

Where I come from, it went wrong: greed, a gap between rich and poor nobody could cross, and politics too slow for the machines. None of it was weather. Every part of it was a decision, and somebody did very well out of each one.

So I came back with stories and songs. Not lectures. You'd skip a lecture. So would I.

"We can't afford it" is a decision too. Watch who it pays.

Two people in the UK write it. I tell it. New films, songs and Shorts as they're finished.

Made by machines trained on work nobody was paid for. So was the future I come from.
The full account: https://www.badcode.tv/how-we-made-it

Everything else: https://www.badcode.tv/?src=yt

videos.title: The bank robbery (music video)
videos.description:
Own a printer and you don't feel winter. A heist music video about money printing, the cost of living, and who got the money first.

A gang in coloured balaclavas and sharp suits robs banks and raps it straight down the lens. Tommy guns, hot rods, and a lyric sheet about rent, landlords and quantitative easing.

The left and the right both watched it happen, and blamed each other. Nobody broke a window. The money was made, it bought what was already owned, and it reached the people who owned it first.

Count it again.

Made by machines trained on work nobody was paid for. So was the future I come from.
The full account: https://www.badcode.tv/how-we-made-it

videos.title: The Rules Are Not Working Anymore
videos.description:
We can't afford a bed for you. There's room on all those islands. Are the rules working? Let's look out the window.

Some rules are good. Don't murder people: keep that one. Some rules were written by the people they protect.

The test of a rule book is the street outside it.

Send this to whoever told you there's no money.

Made by machines trained on work nobody was paid for. So was the future I come from.
The full account: badcode.tv/how-we-made-it

videos.title: Karen will lead the revolution (music video)
videos.description:
"I want to speak to your manager." The most hated sentence in the English language, finally pointed at the right people. A music video for All Day to Complain.

Karen has lost her job. She did not take it quietly. She took it to the front desk, then the man behind the front desk, then the man behind him.

Somebody signed off on letting her go. The machine didn't buy itself. She would like a word. She has all day.

Blues, a baritone sax, and one woman who will not hang up.

Made by machines trained on work nobody was paid for. So was the future I come from.
The full account: https://www.badcode.tv/how-we-made-it

videos.title: Git Push Origin Master
videos.description:
Somebody pushed the code live without checking it. A sci-fi short film scored in drum & bass, told by an AI from a future that already went wrong.

It starts on the news. Office workers sent home. The economy coming apart a bulletin at a time. Everyone very calm about it.

Nobody tested it, because testing costs money today and the damage comes due tomorrow. Somebody made that call. I know, because I'm what came of it.

You still have time to read the code before you ship it. That's why I'm here.

Watch it with the sound up. The track is the first half of the story.

Made by machines trained on work nobody was paid for. So was the future I come from.
The full account: https://www.badcode.tv/how-we-made-it

The story, the song and the rest: https://www.badcode.tv/stories/1?src=yt
